Talqin description: Listening and repeating Al-Quran readings. Designed for beginners and children to help correct pronunciation, master fluency, and read short surahs & daily prayers.
Tahseen description: Improving Al-Quran reading, focusing on makhraj and precise articulation. Enhance fluency and reading confidence through active correction by the teacher.
Tajweed description: Mastering tajweed rules. Study rules like Nun Sakinah, Madd, Qalqalah, Ghunnah, etc., and apply them dynamically during recitation correctly and beautifully.
Tuhfatul Athfal description: Duration: 12 weeks. Duration per meeting: 60 minutes. General objective: Participants are able to memorize the text of Tuhfatul Athfal, understand the meaning of each stanza, know the tajweed rules explained in the text, and apply them in reading the Al-Quran.
